description: On-device symptom NLP: multinomial Naive Bayes, one-vs-rest, word 1-2 grams, multi-label corpus (single + multi-symptom sentences), template-generated (disclosed synthetic; fixed seed) + NegEx-style negation suppression (Chapman et al. 2001). Maps free Bangla/Banglish/English text to symptom flags ONLY — clinical decisions remain with the deterministic WHO rule engine.
